verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a reasonable thing to ask of a SaaS incident-management platform with an API and an MCP server, so the axis applies. The evidence documents no sandbox org, test environment, or isolated non-production data. The closest features are previews: AI retrospective templates previewed against a past incident, and AI SRE investigation rules previewed against recent alerts. These are dry-runs on real data, not sandbox isolation, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
